title: Lamarck vs Darwin
text: A common misconception is that organisms change IN RESPONSE TO their environment (Lamarckism). Darwin's theory states that variation already EXISTS in a population, and the environment then SELECTS which variants survive.

title: Random Mutations
text: Bacteria reproduce rapidly and mutations occur randomly during DNA replication. In a large population, some bacteria will have mutations that happen to provide antibiotic resistance - these mutations occurred BEFORE the antibiotic was present, not because of it.
